[b]Special Military Operation in Southern Amarallo[/b]

[pre]Gendarmite National Broadcasting Network | The Daily Bird | Tumultoria International[/pre]

[i]The Gendarmite Commonwealth has officially announced the beginning of a 'Special Military Operation' in Southern Amarallo to 'pacify' the region and secure the integrity of the Gendarmitre Raj. An expedition force of an estimated 15.000 - 40.000 armed expeditoniaires consisting of the Gendarmite Colonial Security Force and the Rajyami Armed Forces have been called upon to execute these orders. What Gendarme's intentions concerning the successful capture of said 'unpacified' territory is still currently confidential.

[b][u]Kundacier Maharaja Palace, Gendarmite Raj[/u][/b]

The Maharaja's hands brushed through his short black beard, his fingers lingering for a moment as if drawing strength from the quietude of the palace. His turban sat heavy on his head, serving as the paragon of nobility among the commoners of the Raj. For there was no man stronger than the Maharaja in his Raj, even the pale men who claimed to be from lands far away respected him as their king in his realm. But this was no time for the Maharaja to feel prideful of his status. A large map encompassed one half of the marble-covered walls of the palace room. The contents of the map showed a projection of the island that the Raj stood so proudly on, but the focus of the map was not the Raj. The map was jarred with the strokes of red marker, its messy lines made the projection almost unreadable. But these lines all had one thing in common - they all pointed toward a portion of the island that the Maharaja had shown interest in.

"[b]Oh, my once-glorious Maha-Vajra, your lands lie dismantled and engulfed in the flames of turmoil. But this will not last forever. I am coming to save you. By any means necessary, will I reunite your stolen lands, even if it means covering my very own hands with the blood of my brothers and sisters who reject you - as they have rejected me.[/b]"

He recited, his eyes staring madly into the projection of his idolized homeland - as if it were an endless abyss. The Maharaja swiftly turned his head. Before him stood a maple-wood table, littered with hundreds of papers. He rummaged through these papers to find a blue file that contained documents of significant importance for his plan. His fingers grazed through the contents of the file until he stopped at the document of interest. As he stripped it from the file, it revealed what seemed to be the placement of his forces.

To his right stood a traditional telephone that he used to contact the Rajyami Military. The telephones traditional method of communication made it impossible for enemy forces to intercept any messages sent by the Maharaja and back, which was why it was his preferred form of communication. The Maharajas dark fingers slid across the telephone, pushing multiple numbers until a confidential phone line was dialed.

Soon a voice spoke, sounding stern yet respectful. "[b]This is Grand Director Kshatrendra Rathore of the Rajyami Armed Forces reporting, what is of your interest my highness?[/b]"

"[b]Mobilize all active forces in Vishrampur, Madhurva, Jayanara, Rajendraal. Today is the day we come out of hiding, today is the day the world will hail the Raj in all of her glory![/b]" He quickly responded, the Maharaja's tone transitioned from a tranquil manner to him almost sounding as if he turned mad. 

"[b]B-but what about the original protocol!, we cannot go about this without warning or unprovoked! The amount of innocent lives at stake is disproportionate to the potential surplus of starting the offensive unnoticed! What about the Gendarme?!, how will they approve of this![/b]" The General said in a stammering voice, such action left him in shock as he began to question whether or not his beloved Maharaja had become insane. He could not imagine the innocent Maha-Vajrans who had nothing to do with the Raj's greed for conquest. 

"[b]ARE YOU CRAZY?! I AM YOUR MAHARAJA!, YOUR KING! I AM THE MAN WHO YOU SWORE YOUR LIFE TO OBEY AND PROTECT! DO YOU GENUINELY THINK THE GENDARMITES WILL BOTHER AT ALL!? THEY'RE NOTHING BUT GREEDY PIGS!, DO YOU THINK THEY'LL GIVE A SINGLE F*CK ABOUT HOW MANY INNOCENT LIVES ARE LOST??? AS LONG AS WE KEEP PUMPING OIL TO THEM THEY WON'T DO ANYTHING TO STOP US!, HELL THEY'LL EVEN HELP OUT![/b]" The Maharaja's voice flooded with tabooed swears and insults directed at his General, he could not seriously believe the man he trusted the most would actually question [u]his[/u] actions as if he was insane. 

The call soon morphed into silence, the Maharaja would hang up already knowing that this fit of rage coerced the General into following through. He turned back and looked once again at the large projection of the island that he pledged to re-unite, blankly starring into it as if it was an abyss...[/i]

[spoiler=[b]Dead Ahead[/b]]
[pre]With the total executive authorization of the Gendarmite Central Command Agency, the Rayjyami Armed Forces(RAF), the Gendarmite Amarallan Colonial Security Force(GACSF) and the Gendarmite Aegis Solutions(GAS) will all have universal consent from the Gendarmite Central Command Agency to operate in Southern Amarallo(Maha-Vajra). 

[03.18.25]
Time:18-30 Amarallan Standard Time(AST)

The roar of heavy engines engulfed all other inferior mediums, the 13th Armored Brigade was a formidible entity ran by the RAF, GACSF, and GAS. The first objective of the expedition was to capture the Ukrai bridge, which connected the Gendarmite Raj to the Ravana region of the Maha-Vajra which was separated by the Kramol river. The 13th Armored Brigade would be in charge of leading the spearhead into the Ravana. And so by dusk the division smashed into uncharted territory[/pre][/spoiler]

(Natural Expansion post part 1, ~1,000 words)

[b]The Eyes 
[/b]
The Reichswehr had been building up its surveillance and intelligence systems for years since the military reforms. A comprehensive, unified intelligence gathering machine had been built up over the decades. Now the time had come for it to be put into action by identifying the precise positions of Bobian military assets. 

Several intelligence and surveillance tactics combined would help to detect Bobian positions. Optical and infrared imaging from the NRO would be used to detect heat signatures from Bobian vehicles. Synthetic aperture would provide satellite based imaging that would allow the Reichswehr to identify vehicles, troop movements and positions even under the cover of camouflage. SIGINT satellites would move to intercept enemy communications and radar emissions to detect positions. 

However, the intelligence machine wouldnt be limited to satellite surveillance. Craft including the RQ-4 would provide high-altitude surveillance over Bobian positions and provide near real time assessments of the battlefield. The RQ-4 and RC-135 would collect electronic intelligence, imagery and positions of vehicles while craft such as the MQ-9 would be used to collect even more data on enemy positions and vehicles. The vast array of optical, thermal and radar sensors would track Bobian vehicles as they moved to counterattack. 

Reich Cyberverteidigung would aid in the intelligence gathering effort as well. A series of cyber assaults by the RC would aim to grab intelligence on troop and vehicle movements as well as deployment and mission planning. Cyber units including the tailored access operations would move to gain access to Bobian communications and information on top of inserting trojan malware to track movements. Automated deep packet inspections would allow Reichswehr AI systems to sort through massive amounts of intercepted data to pinpoint Bobian assets and positions. 

Processing all of this data would be done through a variety of systems that would allow a constant flow of information within the Reichswehr. SAR and ATR analysis by AI and automated systems would allow the Reichswehr to collate the massive amounts of data received. Combining the collation of satellite, drone and ground intelligence with machine learning would allow a dynamic and quick Reichswehr response. 

[b]Kinetic Strike
[/b]
The data and collation had been done. The intelligence machine of the Reichswehr would help it to identify the positions of the Bobians and their military movements with extreme accuracy. 

Electronic warfare attacks would commence. EW aircraft would emit radio signals to disrupt and overload enemy radar. As the strike came, Reichswehr forces would use EW spoofing and deception to confuse Bobian forces on the direction of strikes. Kinetic strikes would also be used on Bobian radars as AGM-88 HARM anti-radiation missiles that would hone in on the electronic signals of the radars. Reich Cyberverteidigung would attempt to hack integrated air defense systems to remotely disable key Bobian AA components on top of using data poisoning to try to trick AA systems into misidentifying enemy aircraft as friendly or civilian. 

F-15s which would remain back in less saturated airspace would launch AGM-88 HARMs which would use a combination of radiation signatures and intelligence to track and destroy AA systems. AGM-158 JASSMs from the F-15s would be launched towards AA systems as well as SDBs. The RCCAs which would be in more saturated airspace would also deliver PGMs onto AA systems. 

A hail of 316 tomahawk missiles from the Kaiserliche Marine would be delivered towards long-range AA systems, command centers and coastal defenses. The missiles would stay low to the ground to avoid radar detection on top of their small radar cross section which would make them extremely hard to detect and intercept. Saturation tactics would also be attempted so that even if some were shot down by Bobian AA systems, enough would be able to make it through to hit their targets. The F-16CJ, specialized in attacks against AA systems, would be armed with HARM missiles and EW pods to strike Bobian AA. Again, RCCAs would be used to penetrate deep into Bobian territory and use PGMs to attack AA systems. 

The intelligence and surveillance of the Bobians and their mercenaries would also prove to be a problem. To blind their satellites, the Reichswehr would activate ASATs and co-orbital ASATs to destroy Bobian satellites and work to undermine their ability to gather intelligence and communicate. A fresh volley of hypersonic glide vehicles would be used to strike the remainder of the Bobian fleet as well as coastal defences and AA systems. 

Reichswehr contingencies for electronic warfare would move into place as the SWAP systems came online. Frequency hopping and spectrum spreading technologies would be used to quickly and effectively mitigate jamming attacks. The strikes carried out by the Reichswehr would be defended using anti-jamming and encrypted GPS systems. 

[b]Naval Front
[/b]
The Kaiserliche Marine would defend its fleet using a multi-layered defense system. SPY-6 and SPY-1 radars would be able to quickly detect the incoming projectiles combined with the tracking system provided by AEGIS as well as over the horizon satellite systems. First, the electronic warfare defenses would activate. The Slick-32 would jam incoming enemy missile guidance systems as well as radars. Nulka decoys would also be employed to mimic the ships signatures and misguide the incoming projectiles as well as laser dazzlers that would be used to blind incoming missile seekers. 

If the missiles and projectiles were able to weather all the EW systems as well as the cyberattacks by Reich Cyberverteidigung they would have to face the three layered missile defense system. Engaging incoming projectiles at over 200 miles, the SM-6 would provide the first layer of interception defense. If the Bobians had deployed ballistic missiles the SM-3 would be deployed for long-distance interception. In the case that the Bobian projectiles were able to bypass the EW and long-range interception systems they would have to contend with the mid-range systems. The ESSM aboard the Kaiserliche Marine would be specialized to intercept missiles that are supersonic or were taking evasive maneuvers. At this stage, the rolling airframe missiles would be deployed to strike anti-ship and cruise missile threats. 

Finally if the Bobian missiles had bypassed EW, long-range interception and mid-range interception, the close-range defenses would be used. On top of Nulka there would be the SeaRAM systems which would act as point-defense aboard Kaiserliche Marine ships. SeaRAM, a combination of the CIWS and RAM, would combine missile interception with rapid fire interception. HELs aboard the ships would also use high-energy directed weapons to intercept the missiles and projectiles at the last stage. 

As the Bobians struck, the Kaiserliche Marine would hit back harder. 

The Reichswehr counter offensive would also follow a multi-layered system. 

The Maritime Strike Tomahawk missiles aboard the missile carriers of the Kaiserliche Marine would act as the long-range strike platforms of the Marine. Hundreds would be launched towards the destroyers, cruisers, carriers and remaining ships of the Bobian fleet that had survived the first hypersonic volley. SM-6 Dual Purpose Missiles would be combined with the MST missiles as the long-range strike mechanism to engage enemy aircraft, cruise missiles and ships at extended distances. Finally, the deadliest weapon of the long range strike apparatus would be unleashed on the Bobians. The Naval Strike Missile, a sea-skimming missile which would stay low on the surface of the water to avoid detection and interception would be launched in the hundreds towards the remaining Bobian fleet. The Bobian fleet at port would be an easy target for the massive amount of MSTs being launched towards their positions. 

Long-range anti-ship missiles would be launched from F/A-18s and RCCAs towards the Bobian fleet. The LRASM would utilize stealth and AI based systems to evade interception and detection. Harpoon missiles would also be launched from Kaiserliche Marine submarines and ships. The Bobian navy lacking any submarines would allow the Kaiserliche Marine to have a significant edge in underwater warfare. The nuclear stealth submarines of the Marine would be allowed to constantly disrupt and attack the Bobian fleet as well as their supply lines. Constantly resupplying the fleet would be the naval TRAM system which would allow at-sea resupply on top of the use of Kaiserliche Marine naval bases. 

[b]The Air War
[/b]
The 200 km range of the Meteor BVRAAMs would not be able to reach the AWACs as they would remain behind the F-15s and RCCAs. The range of the AWACs to be able to detect aircraft at distances of 400 kilometers would ensure that their effectiveness would not be diminished. However, the Meteor BVRAAMs targeted towards them would not be effective due to range limitations. 

Before moving forward to attempt to dogfight Lüftstreitkrafte aircraft at the maximum 160 km range of the AMRAAMs, the aircraft would have to face the RCCAs that populated the saturated airspace. Moving their fourth generation aircraft into densely saturated areas would allow the RCCAs to strike. Unloading their payloads of AMRAAMs the cheaper CCAs could be deployed by the hundreds acting as a massive force multiplier for the Lüftstreitkrafte. As the SummitONE forces had to contend with the CCAs and their AAMs, the F-15s in less saturated airspace would launch their AIM-260 JATM missiles with a range in excess of 200 km. The longer-distance missiles and CCAs of the Lüftstreitkrafte would allow them to engage the SummitONE aircraft without placing the F-15s and manned systems in significant risk. 

[b]Diplomatic Overtures
[/b]
The Kaiserliche Kriegskommand(Imperial War Command), although known for its fierce defense of the imperial state, was also deeply pragmatic. A war between the Kaiserreich and SummitONE would be extremely costly for both sides, they calculated. An extended war between the imperial state and the private military group would be detrimental for both sides. It would cut into the funds of the state and cut into the profit margins of the company. So, on this opinion they dispatched representatives to SummitONE to discuss a possible deal between the two parties. One where both sides could reap gains. 

[nation]Norrhollow[/nation] - Diplomatic channels are being opened by the Kriegskommand to find a mutually beneficial resolution for both the company and the imperial state. 

[nation]British Republic of Bob[/nation]

[b]March 20, 2025  Port Thriump
[/b]
[i]Personal Journal Entry  Field Correspondent, Etherniasti Free Press
[/i]
The air here still tastes of smoke and ruin. Its been two days since the Sal-Baliz missile strike, and yet the stench of burning metal and ash lingers in the air, as if the ground itself refuses to forget.

I stand at the entrance of what used to be BloomMall, a once-thriving shopping district that had been the heart of weekend life in Port Thriump. Families used to gather here, couples on dates, kids chasing each other through the plaza. Now, its barely standing.

The glass dome that once let in the sunlight? Shattered, collapsed in on itself like a broken spine. Charred storefronts line the corridors, their neon signs melted beyond recognition. A half-destroyed escalator, its metal frame twisted like it was ripped apart by some monstrous hand, leads to nowhere.

I see rescue workers still digging through debris, searching for the missing. A woman sits on the pavement, clutching a burned childrens shoe in her hands, whispering a name over and over.

The official death toll stands at 548, with over 2,000 injured, but every survivor Ive spoken to says the real number feels much higher. The hospitals are overflowing, and the roads leading out of the city are lined with makeshift memorials, candles flickering in defiance against the destruction.

Despite the devastation, aid has begun to arrive from Etherniastis allies. Emergency teams of [nation]United Hydronia[/nation], and the empire of [nation]Akhratia[/nation] are already on the ground, assisting local efforts. Medical tents bearing the insignia of foreign humanitarian organizations dot the outskirts of the ruined district, with doctors and nurses rushing to stabilize the wounded. Dozens of warships, frigates, and supply vessels stand guard in the harbor, a reminder that Etherniasti will not be caught off guard again. The water reflects the flickering firelight of still-smoldering wreckage, but also the steel hulls of a military now fully awake.

And now, as I walk through the wreckage of BloomMall, the news is playing on nearly every remaining screen in the cityEtherniasti has launched bombing runs on [nation]Sal-Baliz[/nation]

For the first time in days, I feel something beyond sorrow. Justice is being delivered. The images of Etherniastis warplanes striking enemy targets are on every channel, and I see people stopping in the streets to watch. Some stand in silence, others nod grimly. Some whisper "About time."

A rescue worker stops me. His hands are caked in soot and dried blood, his eyes hollow. He shakes his head when I ask about the recovery efforts.

"Were finding more than just wreckage," he murmurs. I dont need him to elaborate.

[b]OF ANGELS AND MORTALS[/b]
[i]2: Ayana-3, The Coastal Fortress[/i]]
[i]Makina has moved its capital two times since the beginning of the Second Awakening.

The oldest capital, Ayana-1 or just Ayana, was flooded by rising sea levels. The outer suburbs of the old capital which were not flooded were designated as Ayana-2.

In 1984, Ayana-2 was struck by a nuke launched by Xi-angese militants during the onset of the East Mayeran War. Despite the significant amount of damage the city took on as a result of the explosion, the Makinese government did not officially move the capital away from the now-irradiated city. Many people were forced to live in these apocalyptic conditions, unable to leave Ayana-2 because much of the city's infrastructure had been obliterated by the nuclear bomb.

In 1990, the government officially announced the creation of Ayana-3, a highly-reinforced and fortressed city that would become the pride and joy of Makina in the world of the Second Awakening. Nestled in the valleys of the south, the city was believed to truly be impenetrable; indestructible even.  

In 1995m they were proven wrong. An ungodly and highly destructive creature known as the First Apostle suddenly appeared. It levelled much of the original structure of Ayana-3 in its destructive rampage on the city. Itn the wake of its rampage, it became abundantly clear more needed to be done to make Ayana-3 as strong and as resilient as it could possibly be.

Makina cannot risk losing another capital city.[/i]

...

Hiro Kizumi is standing at a payphone in the desolate streets of Ayana-3. 

From what he saw on the internet, Ayana-3 is supposed to be a bustling metropolis. The barren and near-silent state of the city belies that vision, clearly.

Where is everyone, anyway?

After inserting a coin in, he tries to call the number handed to him in the letter he received from RION. Supposedly, somebody was going to pick him up to take him to RION headquarters once he showed up in Ayana-3. Her name was Emi Yamada, and according to the information he had received, she was a colonel at the organisation.

Clearly, this "Emi" was terrible with keeping up with her duties, because she was nowhere to be found at all.

After a few seconds of buzzing and dial tones, a robotic female voice responds to Kuro's call. [i]The Government of Makina has declared a state of emergency for the following prefectures -HAGANA, NAGISA, NATIONAL ADMINISTRATIVE (AYANA PREFECTURE)-. In accordance with government procedure, all public services have been temporarily halted until the state of emergency is lifted. Please make your way to your nearest shelter immediately. Thank you for your time.[/i]

The line is abruptly cut. Kuro curses to himself, and looks around for help.

All the windows have been shuttered and closed. No lights are on inside any of the buildings.

[i]Well, now I know why the city is quiet. But where the hell is everyone right now?[/i] Kuro thinks to himself.

Out of the corner of his eye, he suddenly spots another person nearby. He turns around to face them.

She's a beautiful girl, probably no older than he is. She has cream-coloured fur and her hair is chocolate brown. Her hair is straight and runs all the way down to her waist. Her face is neutral; she is expressing no emotion of any kind, not even a slight one, anyway. She is wearing a dainty school uniform; it probably belongs to one of the schools in the city.

Kuro calls out to her. "H-hey! Can you help me, lady? Please-"

Out of nowhere, a huge gust of wind rushes through the streets of the city. Dust is kicked up into the air, forcing Kuro to close his eyes.

After the dust clears, he opens his eyes. The girl has disappeared.

Where did she go?

Before he can begin looking for her, the wind begins to pick up again. This time, he can clearly see the source of the wind.

A number of planes from the Ayana State Forces are hovering above the buildings. They are all pointed in the direction of something in the distance, way out of Kuro's view.

From behind the valleys, a giant creature presents itself. It is far bigger than any of the buildings in Ayana-3, and looks akin to that of a hairless Kane. It lacks a tail of any kind and its face is obscured by a circular bone-coloured mask with two dark holes in it, presumably for its eyes. Its skin is a dark green, like the colour of a swamp, and its upper body is much larger and broader than its legs.

It's the First Apostle. Kuro has seen it on the news.

He doesn't know what to do. He is paralyzed in fear. The Apostle continues to make its way through the city, indiscriminately swinging its hands at the airplanes around it. To it, the Ayana State Forces are annoying flies, buzzing around its head.

The Apostle manages to swat one of the planes with its hand. The stricken vehicle falls out of the sky, and begins to careen towards Kuro. It narrowly misses him, crashing into one of the buildings in front of him and exploding in a giant fireball. The shockwave knocks him to the ground, and he closes his eyes in fear as the burning flames continue to rage towards him.

He opens his eyes once the explosion is gone. For a split second, Kuro thought he had died and had crossed over the Rainbow Bridge. 

He hadn't. Out of thin air, a small car was now parked in front of him lengthways. The driver inside had protected him from the blast.

Before he can get up on his feet, the car's passenger door opens. Inside, Emi is sitting at the wheel.

[i]"Hey Kuro, sorry I'm late - all the roads were blocked. Now come on, get in. I was supposed to drop you off at RION headquarters 40 minutes ago!"[/i]

Kuro stutters. She's absolutely stunning.

"U-uh... Yes, Ms. Y-Yamada!"

He quickly stumbles into the car and shuts the door behind him. Immediately, Emi guns the car in reverse and begins to drive as fast as she can, away from the First Apostle and away from the fighter jets in the sky.
[/spoiler]

The Plight of an Empire]

[b]Dareli[/b] 

There was Hardly a Sun by the time I rose out of bed, the sky remained mostly darkened, with the exception of twilight in the east. The Electrical lamps in my room were always on, although hardly bright enough to keep me out of sleep. I always had to wake up early,  the Empire required tending every day, even at such an hour it was necessary. 

Welar had never seen such troubling times before. The Empire remained stable, but it grew weaker every day in face of potential adversaries. Inostrancevia had the honor, the rare, and noble, honor, of never being colonized by a foreign power in its history. It had rather been isolated both by its extreme circumstances and its own leaders, leaving the nation who persisted in the Chaotic lands of the Far Northwest of Shamat to fend for itself. This isolation had brought about relative peace, but also issue. No one dared steered toward Inostrancevia thanks to some slightly exaggerated claims by fishermen who said that beasts hardly capable of putting down a small fishing boat could take down entire fleets. Of course, terrible beasts did persist in the waters off the coast, but infact they had been hunted extensively and were no longer a serious danger to anything but the smallest fishing boats.

Either way, his dynasty had ruled over Inostrancevia for generations, lasting since the mid 1500s, and had culminated with him, Welar Malakai. Inostrancevia was stable, but the rumors were speaking of increasing unrest beyond their borders, and while Inostrancevia wasnt too far behind technologically it lacked the resources to maintain a large and effective military.

Welar knew something had to change, the Empire had to open up.



Johann was kept up by his studies all night, he couldnt afford to fall asleep, heavy as his eyes were. His parents were absolute in their orders that he was to complete his studies as soon as possible, and in fairness they were probably right. They wanted him, his brothers and sister on the Council of Inostrancev as soon as possible. In order to do that, he needed to ace an exam. As a noble, he was entitled and guaranteed such a position with simply a test, although technically anyone could join the council they would need to spend years going through tests, training and conditioning to do so, and that costs money, which left out most of the population.

Even so, the Council was prestigious. It was basically second only to the grand emperor himself, and would discuss and decide numerous rules in the country.  The issue is however, that he personally only half-heartedly wanted to be on it. Most of the reason he wanted to was to please his parents, since they were the nobles of the upper peninsula after all, and the job was to make sure as much of the council as possible was filled by them.

But what he wanted in life was different. All he wanted to be was free, to be with his mount, to travel, to simply not be bound by borders that encompassed his world whole. Unfortunately, he had the displeasure of knowing that life was not that simple, and even for a noble like him there were limitations. Emperor Welar controlled all, even him, even his family, and the country was his servant.

But for now day had dawned, and he could call it in for his studies, because now he had to get to the grand training campus. He got out of his old wooden chair, hearing quite the scene downstairs, he guessed it was his brother Jamestz, who was always up early bragging about being first, and Sito, who claimed he would outpace him. He and his sister Janaciq were more reserved, Sito and Jamestz both had dragons, and could easily outpace him and his sister. His mount couldnt fly, and she drove a car.

So as he walked down the stairs he saw the door wide open, of course his brothers forgot to close the palace doors. He made sure to close them behind him and as he walked out he could see his brothers on their mounts, flying and fading into the distance as they raced to get to the campus. He sighed, walking to the stables so he could also get there.

Hey boy. He said to his mount as he opened the stable, The Dinosaur perked up, its feathery coat ruffling. He scratched his chin as he got onto the saddle.

Another day. He said as they set off to deal with the hell that was his brothers.

Exam]

[b]Dareli[/b] 

Johann flipped his Exam Page over, sighing as he finally completed the full test. Eighty Questions of pure pain and torture. His Instructor, and instructor of the solid 3 Dozen Students that were in training to be part of the council, grabbed the paper as soon as he indicated he was finished. His Instructor, Athmet Garuson, was an old man, roughly 55 years of age, his beard was visibly graying as was what little hair he had left. Johann was almost certain he was the last to finish, and he was proven correct when his teacher blew the whistle after about 15 minutes.

Exam period is over. Athmet said with his old yet wise voice. There was a sigh from the whole room, in total, Three-Hours and Sixteen minutes had elapsed since the test started, and that, in his opinion, was far too much.

I bet I did the best! Jamestz proclaimed, Sito protested, attempting to declare victory, but he and his sister were more reserved. He wanted to make his parents proud, but he didnt really  want to become part of the council too much. 

Relax, the lot of you! Athmet spoke over the quickly devolving ruckus of the class, and with his authoritative voice they all quieted down, although he, and some other students, were already quiet.

These test results I saw coming from miles away. He began, taking out a wooden stick and pointing to a Map of the World, Half you couldnt even point to our own country on the map, and at this point in education a significant amount of you will be regressing your grade.

There was nervous shuffling, he and one of his friends, Zamat, eyed eachother from across the room. Zamat had been his friend since he was 15, he was a noble, a lesser known family but still a noble. He, his sister and Zamat were part of the more Studious group of the class, typically more reversed in their speaking and ambitions, although to call any of them Ambitious was a massive stretch. Zamat simply wanted to be the head of the Inostrancevian Biological preservation department (IBPD) which oversaw the conservation of certain species, something he and Zamat both had interest in, given their mounts were typically considered Rare Species.

As for his sister, he wasnt sure exactly what she wanted, she didnt talk to him a lot, or to anyone besides their parents, but she didnt strike him as particularly ambitious either.

Anyway. He snapped out of his daze as he heard Athmet speak, I believe, as per the mandate of the council for these training sessions, it is time I get to announce your test scores publicly.

Some of the whispering kids froze, although he and a few others were sitting and staring at Athmet with attention.

Anyway, starting from the highest Athmet began reading the names aloud.

Johann Krevlic, Eighty out of Eighty Questions correct. Athmet said.

As expected, his brothers stared back at him in Shock. He gave them a grin and a thumbs up.

Janaciq Krevlic, Seventy-Eight out of Eighty questions correct. Athmet said, announcing his sister's score, then continued on to Zamat, who got 77 Questions correct. They continued on, until they got through almost the whole list.

Sito Krevlic, Eleven out of Eighty Questions correct. Athmet said, Sito was speechless, Jamestz watched with horror as his own score was announced.

Nine out of Eighty Questions correct!

Objection! Sito proclaimed, There is no way Little Johann got a Perfect score while we got this low! Fraud! Fraud!

Athmet laughed.

Johann got a perfect score because instead of talking with girls all day he puts time and passion into studying, as did my top 5 students, and these are graded by expensive unbiased machines. Athmet said, If anything, the only fraud here is however you got this far

Sito slammed his fist on the desk and walked out, followed by Jamestz. He watched them as they went, they were clearly going to get a talking-to from their parents.

Your parents will all be informed of these results in due time, in the meantime, you are free to return home as mandated by end semester rules.

And so the class uneventfully dispersed out the door, through the massive (Perhaps oversized) building. However on the way out he heard footsteps behind him, and surprisingly his sister's voice.

Johann, I need to talk to you urgently. She said.

Well, that's a first. He said.

I am deadly serious. She said, Please, just follow me to my car, we cant risk [i]them[/i] hearing us.

Them? He asked.

I will tell you more, just please come with me. She said.

Alright He said as he was dragged to her boxy SUV. He sat down in the passenger's seat and was still fumbling with the seatbelt when the car pulled out and began driving along the road, as he buckled in she began to talk.

Listen, Johann, you know how our parents are nobles right? She asked.

Yeah?

Well, to put it simple, they made people mad, the kind of people you dont ever want to make mad. Janaciq said, As in The Reigning Emperor of Inostrancevia kind of people.

How did they anger Welar? He asked.
